text:
INT. HOSPITAL HALL - NIGHT

A nurse confirms SAM is dead. Sheet up. Machines quiet.

NURSE
Time of death, 02:14. Sam was killed in the crash.

CUT TO:

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

Sam walks in, stands there smiling, hands Maya coffee.

SAM
Traffic was light. CONTINUITY_BREAK: alive again after the sheet.

MAYA
Did you get bagels?

SAM
I forgot the fire. Also I never died.
